objectives.label: Order ahead (future)
objectives.descriptorEN: Order something for a future day using a modal or 'bi' + present.

objectives.label: Order for an occasion / number
objectives.descriptorEN: Specify a cake for a number of people and an occasion.

objectives.label: Compare + give a reason with 'ker'
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask which is fresher/cheaper and choose, giving a reason with 'ker'.

objectives.label: Check allergens / ingredients
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask whether a product contains an allergen and state your own allergy.

objectives.label: Handle sold-out + substitute
objectives.descriptorEN: React to an out-of-stock item and ask for a substitute with 'namesto'.

objectives.label: Confirm / summarize the order
objectives.descriptorEN: Read the whole order back and ask if it is correct.

objectives.label: Mild repair / correction
objectives.descriptorEN: Politely flag a price mistake or say you didn't understand and ask for a repeat.

objectives.label: Small talk + warm close
objectives.descriptorEN: Make brief weather small talk and close the exchange warmly.

b1.speaker: baker
b1.en: Good day, what can I get you?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Bi eno presto, prosim.
c1a.en: Good day. I'd like a pretzel, please.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.en: Hello. I'd like a croissant, please.

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.sl: Ja, rada bi naročila torto za jutri.
c2a.en: Yes, I'd like to order a cake for tomorrow.

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.sl: Ja, ali lahko naročim torto za jutri?
c2b.en: Yes, can I order a cake for tomorrow?

b3.speaker: baker
b3.sl: Seveda. Za kdaj in za koliko oseb?
b3.en: Of course. For when and for how many people?

c3a.speaker: client
c3a.sl: Za jutri popoldne, za štiri osebe.
c3a.en: For tomorrow afternoon, for four people.

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.sl: Za jutri, za rojstni dan. Za šest oseb.
c3b.en: For tomorrow, for a birthday. For six people.

b4.speaker: baker
b4.sl: Prav. Katero torto želite? Imamo čokoladno in sadno.
b4.en: Alright. Which cake would you like? We have chocolate and fruit.

b5.speaker: baker
b5.sl: Obe sta sveži, danes pečeni. Sadna je malenkost cenejša.
b5.en: Both are fresh, baked today. The fruit one is a touch cheaper.

c5a.speaker: client
c5a.sl: Potem bom vzela sadno, ker je cenejša.
c5a.en: Then I'll take the fruit one, because it's cheaper.

c5b.speaker: client
c5b.sl: Vzela bom čokoladno, ker je bolj okusna.
c5b.en: I'll take the chocolate one, because it's tastier.

b6.speaker: baker
b6.sl: Odlična izbira. Vas zanima kaj glede sestavin ali alergenov?
b6.en: Excellent choice. Would you like to know anything about ingredients or allergens?

c6b.speaker: client
c6b.sl: Sem alergična na sezam. Ali vsebuje sezam?
c6b.en: I'm allergic to sesame. Does it contain sesame?

b7.speaker: baker
b7.sl: Oreškov ne dodajamo, lahko pa vsebuje sledove oreškov in sezama.
b7.en: We don't add nuts, but it may contain traces of nuts and sesame.

c7a.speaker: client
c7a.sl: Aha. Potem bo v redu, hvala.
c7a.en: I see. Then it'll be fine, thanks.

c7b.speaker: client
c7b.sl: Hvala, da ste povedali. Bom pazila.
c7b.en: Thanks for telling me. I'll be careful.

b8.speaker: baker
b8.sl: Bomo dodali še kaj svežega? Priporočam danish s čokolado in pistacijami.
b8.en: Shall we add something fresh? I recommend the chocolate-pistachio danish.

c8a.speaker: client
c8a.sl: Ja, dva danish s pistacijami, prosim.

b9.speaker: baker
b9.sl: Joj, danish s pistacijami je pošel, nimamo ga več. Imamo pa navadne s čokolado. Bi te?
b9.en: Oh, the pistachio danish is sold out, we don't have any more. But we have plain chocolate ones. Would you like those?

c9a.speaker: client
c9a.sl: Lahko namesto tega dva navadna danish?
c9a.en: Can I have two plain danishes instead?

c9b.speaker: client
c9b.sl: V redu, potem pa eno focaccio.

c10a.speaker: client
c10a.sl: Torej: torto za jutri, ostalo pa za zdaj. Je tako prav?
c10a.en: So: the cake for tomorrow, the rest for now. Is that right?

b11.speaker: baker
b11.sl: Tako je. Skupaj bo osem evrov in petdeset, prosim.
b11.en: That's right. Altogether it'll be eight fifty, please.

c11a.speaker: client
c11a.sl: Mislim, da ste se zmotili pri ceni.
c11a.en: I think you made a mistake with the price.

b12.speaker: baker
b12.sl: Oprostite, imate prav. Sedem evrov in petdeset, ne osem.
b12.en: Sorry, you're right. Seven fifty, not eight.

c12b.speaker: client
c12b.sl: Aha, oprostite, nisem razumela. Koliko, prosim?
c12b.en: Ah, sorry, I didn't understand. How much, please?

b13.speaker: baker
b13.en: Thank you. Shall I give you a bag?

c13b.speaker: client
c13b.en: No, thanks, I have my own.

b14.speaker: baker
b14.en: Here you go. The cake will be ready tomorrow.

c14a.speaker: client
c14a.en: Great. I'll come for the cake tomorrow.

b15.speaker: baker
b15.sl: Kar računajte na to. Danes je pa res lepo vreme, kajne?
b15.en: You can count on it. Lovely weather today, isn't it?

c15a.speaker: client
c15a.sl: Ja, res je čudovito. Končno pomlad!
c15a.en: Yes, it's really wonderful. Spring at last!

c15b.speaker: client
c15b.sl: Res lepo. Upam, da bo tako tudi jutri.
c15b.en: Really nice. I hope it stays like this tomorrow too.

c16b.speaker: client
c16b.sl: Enako, lep dan še naprej! Nasvidenje.
c16b.en: Same to you, have a lovely day! Goodbye.
